## ⏰ Heartbeat Workflow

Proactive check-in routine that runs every 30 minutes.

**What it does:**
- Checks recent activity patterns
- Respects quiet hours (11 PM - 7 AM)
- Offers help when issues are detected
- Provides gentle check-ins after long silences
- Suggests task reviews when reminders are mentioned

**Smart features:**
- Won't spam - only acts when truly helpful
- Logs all decisions for transparency
- Adapts to user patterns over time
